div.div: غُبْرَانٌ Two ripe dates upon one base; pl. غَبَارِينُ: (K, TA:) so says A'Obeyd: or two, or three, full-grown unripe dates upon one base; and it has no pl. of its own radical letters: or, accord. to AHn, several small green dates that come forth upon one base. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
